text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-e-d a r-a-d-i-o j-a-m-m-e-r t-o m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e w-i-f-i n-o-i-s-e, l-e-f-t d-r-o-n-e f-l-i-g-h-t l-o-g-s w-i-t-h s-i-g-n-a-l d-r-o-p-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y s-p-r-e-a-d a-u-d-i-t.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-p-r-o-g-r-a-m-m-e-d g-p-s o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-s f-o-r t-h-e d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y z-o-n-e, l-e-f-t c-o-n-f-i-g u-p-l-o-a-d h-a-s-h-e-s i-n t-h-e c-l-o-u-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y g-e-o-f-e-n-c-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d a-n-d r-e-b-r-o-a-d-c-a-s-t d-r-o-n-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s, l-e-f-t i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t e-d p-a-c-k-e-t s-a-m-p-l-e-s o-n t-h-e s-t-o-r-a-g-e m-e-d-i-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-o-n k-e-y r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a p-r-e-f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d l-a-n-d-i-n-g z-o-n-e b-e-a-c-o-n a-t t-h-e r-e-c-e-p-t-i-o-n s-i-t-e, l-e-f-t b-a-t-t-e-r-y c-y-c-l-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s s-h-o-w-i-n-g d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e t-r-a-v-e-l, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e f-i-r-m-w-a-r-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-c-a-n.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e a-s a s-u-p-p-l-i-e-r t-e-s-t u-n-i-t t-o m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e o-r-i-g-i-n, l-e-f-t i-n-v-o-i-c-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a w-i-t-h m-i-s-m-a-t-c-h-e-d s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e t-h-r-e-e-w-a-y p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
